We define these capabilities from four aspects... Judgment evaluates... Reasoning evaluates... Deception... Self-awareness... Cooperation... Coordination... Rationality... Win Rate is a straightforward indicator of the success of an LLM in all proposed scenarios.

We define these capabilities from four aspects: cognition, adaptability, rationality, and collaboration: (1) Judgment and reasoning form the core cognition of agents... (2) Self-awareness and deception are key to enhanced adaptability... (3) Rationality serves as a metric to gauge the efficiency... (4) Cooperation and coordination are two facets of collaboration...
